learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion, the student has acquired knowledge in the elective subjects taken, according to their respective descriptions. The content must not significantly overlap with the study program of the respective Master's degree program. More than one course can be taken to achieve the required six CPs.

syllabus_topics: Further elective modules upon application to the Dean of Studies (especially for semesters abroad)
assessment_rules: Assessment performance depends on the chosen elective subjects and is in accordance with the relevant study and examination regulations of the offering study program. The selection of subjects must be approved by the Dean of Studies. 6 CPs must be completed in technical subjects. If multiple graded academic achievements are provided for this, the grades will be weighted according to the CPs.
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Maschinenbau (M.Sc.)
